senses.gloss: (√שד, v. שדי; v. H. Dict. s. v. אֶשֶׁד) to pour out, to shed (blood), to deposit (ashes).
units: <cite ref="Onkelos Leviticus 17:4">Targ. Lev. XVII, 4</cite>; a. fr.—
Sabb. 156ᵃ אָשֵׁיד דמא a shedder of blood.—Part. pass. אָשִׁיד shed, spilt.
<cite ref="Targum Jonathan on Micah 1:4">Targ. Mic. I, 4</cite>; <cite ref="Targum Jonathan on Micah 3:10">III, 10</cite>; a. e.
